extension.summary: Sleep timer with volume fade-out, early TV power-off and screensaver handover.
Sleeptimer mit Lautstaerke-Ausblendung, vorzeitigem TV-Aus und Bildschirmschoner-Uebergabe.
extension.description: Stops playback after a configurable time, fading the volume out gradually so you get a chance to intervene. Optionally switches the TV off earlier while audio keeps playing, which is useful for falling asleep to a movie. Genuine user interaction (pause, seek, volume, key presses) restarts the timer, while Kodi advancing to the next playlist item does not. The TV-off command is treated as a toggle: it is sent once per power-off, retried only when a verification command is configured, and any pending retry is cancelled the moment you wake up.

Beendet die Wiedergabe nach einer einstellbaren Zeit und blendet die Lautstaerke vorher langsam aus, damit man noch eingreifen kann. Optional wird der Fernseher schon vorher abgeschaltet, waehrend der Ton weiterlaeuft. Echte Benutzeraktionen starten den Timer neu, der automatische Wechsel zum naechsten Titel nicht.
extension.news: v3.0.3 - FIX: playlist advancement no longer resets the sleep timer. onPlayBackStarted / onAVStarted / Player.OnPlay are playback lifecycle events, not user interaction. With short files Kodi fired them every ~20 min, which reset a 45 min timer forever and left the TV on all night. - FIX: TV-off retry logic moved into the addon, where it is bounded and cancellable. A retry loop in the shell command kept toggling the TV on and off and could not be stopped on wake-up. - FIX: subprocesses no longer inherit an unread PIPE, which could deadlock a verify command such as 'cec-ctl -S' once the pipe buffer filled. - NEW: optional TV-off verification command with a bounded retry count. - NEW: optional maximum session length, a hard cap that no interaction can extend. - NEW: periodic heartbeat in the log showing the remaining time. - Settings reads are exception-safe, so an addon reload can no longer kill the service thread.
